title.zh: 音符长度不再短于它自己的起音
title.en: A note is never shorter than its own attack

highlights.zh: 修好一类听感问题：起音比音符还长时，音符会在起音中途被切掉，听起来又轻又不完整。全库 318 条轨里有 55 条如此，最严重差了 5 倍。
highlights.en: Fixed a class of voicing problem: when an instrument attacks slower than the note it is given, the note is cut mid-attack and sounds thin. 55 of the catalogue's 318 routed lanes did that, the worst by a factor of five.

highlights.zh: 规则：音符不短于「起音 × 2.5」。实测 breakcore 和弦 −38.9 → −12.0 dBFS（+26.9 dB），GS-1 +10.5 dB；实时引擎与导出器都生效。
highlights.en: The rule: a note is never shorter than its attack times 2.5. Measured on breakcore's chords, −38.9 → −12.0 dBFS (+26.9 dB) and +10.5 dB through GS-1, in both the live engine and the exporter.
